content: {"reasoning":"The missing-authorization denial persists after appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; no claim-data error supports resubmission. With the payer path exhausted, the patient's contractual 10% share is $74.60, so billing should be limited to that amount rather than shifting the authorization-denied payer portion to the patient. Although collections were uncommon in similar cases, billing the properly owed share is preferable to writing it off.","action":"bill_patient"}
